name: Blood Clot doubles Scarlet Delirium's periodic damage (#646)
contract: Blood Clot 680657 effect 2 is aura 108 with MiscValue 22 (SPELLMOD_DOT), BasePoints 99 + DieSides 1 = +100%, over EffectSpellClassMask (0, 0, 256) = word 2 bit 8 = the six Scarlet Delirium records (801074, 803684-803688). Scarlet Delirium's effect 1 is aura 53 PERIODIC_LEECH with Amplitude 3000, and Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone applies SPELLMOD_DOT to periodic damage (damagetype == DOT ? SPELLMOD_DOT : SPELLMOD_DAMAGE), reached from AuraEffect::HandlePeriodicHealthLeech. Tooltip: "Your Scarlet Delirium now deals $s3% increased damage", where $s3 is effect 3's value, 100. Effect 0 is aura 108 with MiscValue 10 (SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME) and BasePoints -1 + DieSides 1 = 0%, an inert no-op. Regression guard for native behaviour.
